thread:
Natasha (CS): quick heads-up — Hemera Labs onboarding: we saw p95 spikes around ~1.8s on chat gen over last 24h and token cost trending +22%. renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, recommend a proactive perf proposal.
Raj (SE): ran a focused eval on their top 200 prompts. int8 quantized candidate `redwood/llama-13b-int8-v1` shows ~35% lower latency p95 and token-cost down ~28%. quality diffs on our eval set are small (avg quality delta ~1.4% by our scoring). can do canary.
Leo (SRE): root cause looks like two things: cold KV cache misses on long sequences and some high-concurrency bursts. ops note: their traffic has 6% long-tail (>512 tokens) requests that amplify batching inefficiencies.
Natasha (CS): MVP proposal for Hemera: (1) 10% canary to int8 model for 48h, (2) enable prefix/KV caching for known prefixes, (3) route heavy-tail customers to dedicated pool during peak window (6pm-10pm UTC) with autoscale buffer.
Marta (Hemera): curious about quality — do you have quick A/B examples? worried about subtle hallucination shifts for our compliance prompts.
Raj (SE): yes — attached quick diff samples below (shortened). we saw one minor phrasing change in 3/200 samples, no factual regressions in compliance set.

```
# A/B sample (prompt id 42)
A (baseline): "List regulatory steps for data retention in EU"
B (int8):      "Steps for data retention in EU include..."  -> minor reorder, same facts
```

Leo (SRE): rollout plan: canary 10% (48h) -> evaluate latency, error_rate, and regen-quality metrics -> if pass, ramp to 50% over 24h with automatic fallback to baseline model on any QoS regression.
OpsBot: deploy-job #deploy-hemera-canary started by Raj — logs streaming: `deploy:started`, `canary:10%`, `kv_cache:enabled`
Amanda (Prod): add explicit eval hooks: capture BLEU/ROUGE + a simple semantic-sim test and store diffs on the console so CS can show Hemera before/after.
Natasha (CS): capture plan for customer call: quick 30m session Tue 10am PT — demo A/B, explain cost savings, propose 2-week pilot. I'll send invite and a short one-pager.
Marta (Hemera): ok schedule sounds good. also: can we get a fallback SLA? if we see any hallucination increase, we want immediate rollback.
Raj (SE): we'll add an automated rollback trigger if semantic-sim drops >3% or error_rate >0.5% absolute. fallback to baseline model and notify both SRE and CS channels.
DevEx: suggest we include a canned eval notebook for Hemera with their sample set + instructions to re-run locally. I'll drop link in the thread :link:
Natasha (CS): action items:
- Raj: set up canary + A/B logs and sample diffs (ETA: today EOD)
- Leo: enable prefix/KV cache and set dedicated routing policy window (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- DevEx: publish Hemera eval notebook and one-pager (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Marta: confirm Tue 10am PT or propose alternate

Marta (Hemera): confirmed Tue 10am PT. thanks team :raised_hands:
Natasha (CS): great — this should reduce their cost curve and reduce renewal risk. will capture feedback in the enablement notes during call and push to renewal brief.
Raj (SE): leaving small note: if Hemera wants even lower cost we can trial int4 compact model but recommend post-canary quality review first.
Leo (SRE): noted. I'll keep an eye on tail latencies and add tracing hooks for the canary traffic.
Natasha (CS): awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
